objective: Repeat the invalidated R106 projection-isolation test from the frozen R104 image, prove that the live XPU call site executes, and localize any surviving request-order branch at the normalized/projected boundary.

treatment.scope: On pure multi-request XPU prefills only, split the final post-normalization GDN out_proj by live request boundaries and concatenate the projected rows in the original order.
treatment.trace: For every pure-prefill invocation, record an execution marker plus exact per-request SHA-256 digests of normalized input and projected output rows, with layer, TP rank, invocation, and live boundaries.

mandatory_treatment_gates.patch_parser: Apply with fuzz zero and fail if stderr/stdout contains trailing garbage, malformed, FAILED, ignored, or reversed.
mandatory_treatment_gates.semantic_source: AST-inspect QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention.forward_xpu and require exactly one call to torch.ops.vllm.qwen_gdn_projection_prefill_isolated_xpu behind the projection-isolation environment gate.
mandatory_treatment_gates.installed_identity: Pin the complete installed source SHA-256.
mandatory_treatment_gates.runtime_execution: Before interpreting outputs, require a non-empty trace file containing both TP ranks and records for the counted pure-prefill workload. Absence invalidates the run.

workload.warmup: One c1 and two c2 requests against a fresh server.
workload.qualification: Three c1 repeats followed by twenty c2 repeats using the frozen realistic two-prompt suite.

output_gate.required: 3/3 c1 and 20/20 c2 batches exact against complete token-ID oracles; every request complete; every cached-token count zero.
output_gate.quality_policy: No throughput claim unless output identity passes. No fixture-only or high-acceptance headline.
output_gate.health: No new xe reset, GPU fault, OOM kill, storage error, or corrupted response.

decision.all_output_exact: Retain as a determinism candidate, then run the cold realistic suite before any speed claim.
decision.order_branch_survives_normalized_digest_: The branch is at or before post-core normalization; do not blame out_proj.
decision.order_branch_survives_normalized_same_pr: The request-local FP8 out_proj is nondeterministic; trace quantization and kernel choice.
decision.treatment_gate_fails: Invalidate immediately and do not interpret token outputs.

resource_boundary: Use 12 GiB container RAM and 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap; no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: Diagnostic candidate only. No README, website, public speed, or LocalMaxxing update from this run.
